# apicurio_rule (Resource)

Manages Apicurio Registry rules (global or per-artifact).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

provider "apicurio" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:3080"
}

# Example: set an artifact-level compatibility rule
resource "apicurio_rule" "artifact_compatibility" {
  scope       = "artifact"
  group_id    = "example.group"
  artifact_id = "example-artifact"

  rule_type = "COMPATIBILITY"
  config    = "BACKWARD"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Rule configuration value, e.g. `BACKWARD`, `FULL`, `NONE`.
- `rule_type` (String) Rule type, e.g. `COMPATIBILITY`, `VALIDITY`.

### Optional

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact ID (required when scope=artifact).
- `enabled` (Boolean) If false, the rule is deleted (disabled).
- `group_id` (String) Group ID (required when scope=artifact).
- `scope` (String) Rule scope: `global` or `artifact`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal Terraform ID. Global: `global/<rule_type>`. Artifact: `<group_id>/<artifact_id>/<rule_type>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Import a GLOBAL rule.
# Format: global/<rule_type>
terraform import apicurio_rule.example "global/COMPATIBILITY"

# Import an ARTIFACT rule.
# Format: <group_id>/<artifact_id>/<rule_type>
terraform import apicurio_rule.example "com.example.common.v1/ErrorCommonMessage/COMPATIBILITY"
```
